mapper.sql: ea.achievement_id as "achievementId", ea.faculty_user_id as "facultyUserId", ea.achievement_type as "achievementType", ea.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", ea.occurrence_date as "occurrenceDate", ea.certification_status as "certificationStatus", ea.attachment_token as "attachmentToken"
mapper.select: select from education_achievements ea order by ea.occurrence_date desc, ea.achievement_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select from education_achievements ea where ea.achievement_id = #{achievementId} and ea.deleted_yn = 'N'

insert into education_achievements (faculty_user_id, achievement_type, management_item_code, occurrence_date, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{facultyUserId}, #{request.achievementType}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.occurrenceDate}, #{changedBy}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}) returning achievement_id as "achievementId", faculty_user_id as "facultyUserId", achievement_type as "achievementType", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", occurrence_date as "occurrenceDate", certification_status as "certificationStatus", attachment_token as "attachmentToken"
mapper.update: update education_achievements set management_item_code = #{request.managementItemCode}, occurrence_date = #{request.occurrenceDate}, updated_by = #{changedBy}, updated_at = current_timestamp, change_reason = #{changeReason} where achievement_id = #{request.achievementId} and deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select degree_type as "degreeType", student_name as "studentName", thesis_title as "thesisTitle", degree_awarded_date as "degreeAwardedDate" from degree_completion_student_details where achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by degree_completion_detail_id

select student_name as "guidanceStudentName", guidance_start_date as "guidanceStartDate", guidance_end_date as "guidanceEndDate", student_count as "studentCount" from student_guidance_details where achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by guidance_detail_id
mapper.insert: insert into student_guidance_details (achievement_id, student_name, guidance_start_date, guidance_end_date, student_count, created_by, updated_by) values (#{achievementId}, #{detail.guidanceStudentName}, #{detail.guidanceStartDate}, #{detail.guidanceEndDate}, #{detail.studentCount}, #{changedBy}, #{changedBy})
mapper.select: select count(*) from input_period_settings where area_code = 'EDUCATION' and active_yn = 'Y' and start_at <= current_timestamp and end_at >= current_timestamp
mapper.update: update education_achievements set certification_status = #{toStatus}, updated_by = #{changedBy}, updated_at = current_timestamp where achievement_id = #{achievementId} and certification_status = #{fromStatus} and deleted_yn = 'N'

update education_achievements set deleted_yn = 'Y', deleted_at = current_timestamp, deleted_by = #{changedBy}, delete_reason = #{deleteReason}, certification_status = 'DELETED', updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by = #{changedBy}, change_reason = #{deleteReason} where achievement_id = #{achievementId} and deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values ('FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT', #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, 'certification_status', #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})

insert into education_achievement_status_histories (achievement_id, from_status_code, to_status_code, changed_by, change_reason) values (#{achievementId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason})
